classification.rationale: The Ballard AHU DEC units cool air by passing it through wetted evaporative media and use no refrigeration or humidity-regulating devices, so they fall outside heading 8415 air conditioning machines. Their principal function under Section XVI note 3 is evaporative cooling, which subheading 8479.60 names eo nomine. No on-point CBP ruling was found in the corpus, so the classification rests on the heading and subheading text.
